summary: This 8-K reports a routine capital call by Crestline Lending Solutions, LLC, where it sold ~923,703 units at $19.62/share for ~$18.1M aggregate under existing subscription agreements with accredited investors. The filing also discloses the board's designation of its investment adviser as valuation designee for NAV determination under the 1940 Act. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special situation event is described. The transaction is a standard equity issuance by a business development company to fulfill its capital commitments from investors, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. There is no change of control, premium, or strategic action for special-situations categorization.
